text:
Gabe R.: Quick flag from the v2 staggered rollout: some tenants show tokens under both v1 and v2 in different dashboards. Looks like routing vs enrichment disagree on attribution.

Ivy S.: Confirmed. Routing applies compat fallback (route=v1) for older SDKs, but enrichment later records model_variant=v2. ETL ends up aggregating both keys.

Ben C.: Example trace: tr_2025_77
```
2025-05-14T10:11:05Z routing: chosen=compat route=v1 tenant=acme-prod trace=tr_2025_77 tokens=420
2025-05-14T10:11:05Z enrichment: model_select=model-v2-quant trace=tr_2025_77
```
So two attribution fields for the same request.

Maya L.: UX risk: console rollforward preview shows "estimated billing delta +5%" which will alarm customers if raw billing doesn't match. Short-term mitigation: hide billed delta for affected cohorts and show a banner "Attribution mismatch detected - preview is sampling-only" with sample trace links.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-999 created for duplicated attribution (https://redwood/incidents/INC-2026-999)

Gabe R.: Engineering fix proposal (low-friction): set canonical header `X-RW-Attribution` at routing decision (values: v1|v2|compat). Downstream enrichment may set model_variant but must not overwrite `X-RW-Attribution`. ETL should prefer `X-RW-Attribution` when present; missing -> default to v1 for billing safety.

Ben C.: Implementation notes + estimates:
- routing: inject header at policy decision + unit/integration tests (4 hrs)
- enrichment/model-router: guard to avoid overwriting header (2 hrs)
- ETL: precedence change + 1% validation backfill (6 hrs)
- console: preview sandbox mode & banner (2-3 hrs)

Total coordinated work ~1 day across teams.

Ivy S.: I'll open the routing PR and add telemetry emission `handshake_mismatch_rate` per-tenant so Console can gate rollforwards.

Maya L.: I'll patch Console to default to sample-only preview when mismatch_rate > 0.5% and add the banner/copy. Lia will draft tenant comms for any customers with >1% mismatch.

ops-bot: Scheduling 1% validation backfill window 02:00-02:30 UTC tonight. Will page oncall if CPU > 70% or p99 latency > 200ms.

Gabe R.: Owners: Ivy (routing + metric), Ben (ETL + backfill), Maya (console + comms). Will update INC-2026-999 with progress. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
